template.html:
Going live · Saturday 24 October
NOVA
BY BRIDGEYE

48 hours to build
something real.

Build With Nova kicks off this Saturday. Bring an idea, pick a track, and ship a working product with Nova CLI as your co-builder.

Join the Discord  →

Required for kickoff, announcements and submissions

KICKOFFSat, 24 Oct

2:00 – 5:00 PM IST

 BUILD WINDOW48 hours

24 – 25 October

 FORMATOnline

Solo or teams of up to 4
The tracks

No fixed problem statement.
Build what you care about.

01
AI for Everyday Life
Productivity, learning, finance, travel, communication and everyday automation.
02
AI for Developers
Tools that help developers write, test, debug, document and automate.
03
Build for the Future
Open track. Any problem, any industry, any idea.
Special challenge
Built With Nova

Open to every track. Recognises the most creative and meaningful use of Nova CLI across your build.

Prizes

What's on the line

Winner · Best overall build
₹5,000 cash
